                    Oct.    7,      40.
1.

MISSING MEDICAL STUDENT.

At 5.25 p.m. 7-10-40, Gordon Road Station
notified this station that at 11 a.m. 7-10-40, a
private motor car, bearing the licence number 1123,
had been seen on Penang Road, facing east, and 200
yards west of Xiaochow Road. It had remained at
this place throughout the day, and appeared to have
been abandoned.

Private motor car licence No.1123 was registered
in the name of Loh Siu Wang (樂香璜), 362/36 Great
Western Road, and Gordon Road Station requested that
an attempt be made to locate the owner.

A visit was paid to 362/36 Great Western Road,
and from Mr. Loh Tsung Tang (樂正堂) contractor,
it was learned that the motor car was the property
of his son Loh Siu Wang, medical student.

Mr. Loh said his son had left home as usual
for college at 8 a.m. 7-10-40, driving his own car,
but had failed to return home for lunch. He always
came home for lunch.

The student's college was at once communicated
with, and it was learned that he had failed to put
in an appearance on 7-10-40.

1.

医学生失踪案。

1940年10月7日下午5时25分，戈登路巡捕房通知本巡捕房称，1940年10月7日上午11时，在槟榔路（Penang Road）上，面朝东，位于小州路（Xiaochow Road）以西200码处，发现一辆牌照号码为1123的私人汽车。该车整天停在该处，似乎已被遗弃。

牌照号为1123的私人汽车注册在乐香璜（Loh Siu Wang）名下，地址为大西路（Great Western Road）362/36号，戈登路巡捕房请求设法寻找车主。

经前往大西路362/36号查访，从承包商乐正堂（Loh Tsung Tang）先生处获悉，该汽车系其子、医学生乐香璜所有。

乐先生称，其子于1940年10月7日上午8时如常驾驶自己的汽车离家去学院，但未回家吃午饭。他以往总是回家吃午饭的。

随即与该生所在学院联系，得知他于1940年10月7日未曾到校。

其父无法说明其子

The motor car was examined for finger prints.
None were found.
School books and papers; driving permit No.
322-L in the name of Loh Siu Wang, and a crumpled
up white surgeon's overall, were found on the front
seat of the car.
The car keys were missing.
The description of the missing student is
LOH SIU WANG (梁秀璋), 25, Ningpo,
m/medical student, Universite' L'Aurore, Avenue
Dubail, F.C., living at 362/36 Great Western
Road, slim build, long thin face, long hair
combed back, dressed in grey foreign suit,
brown shoes, wearing spectacles. Speaks
French and English.
This description has been circulated, and
further enquiries are being made.

Sen. Det. 1/o
